- task_id: roadmap/Q1-XGBoost-Threat-Scoring, summary: Implement XGBoost threat scoring model, links: https://crates.io/crates/xgboost, https://docs.rs/xgboost, https://xgboost.readthedocs.io, suggested_implementation: Use the `xgboost` crate to load a pre-trained booster and call `score()` on each connection feature vector
- task_id: roadmap/Q2-Rust-ML-Inference, summary: Rust-based ML inference - tflite-rust not viable, use ONNX Runtime via `ort` crate, links: https://ort.pyke.io/, https://github.com/pykeio/ort, https://docs.rs/ort/latest/ort/, suggested_implementation: Convert XGBoost model to ONNX via sklearn-onnx/tf2onnx, load with ort::Session, run inference via ort::inputs! macro; supports GPU/NPU via execution providers (CUDA, TensorRT, CoreML)
- task_id: roadmap/Q1-linfa, summary: Classical ML algorithms via linfa as Rust alternative to scikit-learn, links: https://github.com/rust-ml/linfa, https://docs.rs/linfa, https://crates.io/crates/linfa, suggested_implementation: Use linfa crate for classical supervised/unsupervised algorithms; integrate linfa-preprocessing for feature scaling/pipeline as Rust-native sklearn alternative
- task_id: roadmap/Q3-TLS-1.3-IPC, summary: Implement TLS 1.3 support for encrypted IPC, links: https://docs.rs/rustls, https://docs.rs/hyper-rustls, https://docs.rs/tokio-rustls, suggested_implementation: Use `rustls` crate directly or via `hyper-rustls`/`tokio-rustls` for TLS 1.3-secured inter-process communication.
- task_id: roadmap/Q3-Cryptographic-Audit-Logging, summary: Implement SHA-256 signed cryptographic audit logging, links: https://docs.rs/pamoja-audit, https://docs.rs/audit-trail, https://docs.rs/libro, suggested_implementation: Integrate `pamoja-audit`, `audit-trail`, or `libro` to create tamper-evident, hash-chained audit logs with SHA-256 signatures.
- task_id: roadmap/Q3-iptables-rate-limiting, summary: Kernel-level enforcement of detection decisions via iptables/nftables from Rust - prefer nftables JSON API (iptables legacy path on Debian); crates verified live on crates.io 2026-08-22, links: https://crates.io/crates/nftables, https://crates.io/crates/iptables, https://wiki.nftables.org/wiki-nftables/index.php/Configuring_chains, suggested_implementation: Spawn dedicated OS thread consuming ban events from detection pipeline; use `nftables` crate (v0.6.x, safe wrapper over `nft -j` JSON API) to insert per-IP rules into a dedicated RamShield chain with hashlimit sets, falling back to `iptables` crate only
